message: docs: publish the Q3 release notes

files.docs/release-notes-q3.md:
# PulseBoard — Q3 release notes

- Exec dashboard KPI grid ships with six cards (revenue, sessions,
  conversion, carts, refunds, support backlog).
- Cold-start hydration for the metrics bundle moved behind the app shell
  so navigation stays interactive while aggregates load.
- Signed-delta formatting lands for every percentage and count card.
